paite: Unaute aw, mi takhial bangpeuh ahih lai phawk a na omleh nou khamite aw, khemna ka tuak sam kha ding e, chi a kivenghoih kawm in, huai bang mi nunnemna lungsim toh tungding thak nawn un.
heading: Unau Tundingna
english: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

paite: Na puakgikte uh kidawn chiat un, huchi in Khrist dan na zui uh ahi ding.
english: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

paite: Mi bangmah hiloupi in mi liankuam a akibawlleh amah kikhem tawm lel ahi.
english: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

paite: Michih in amah thilhih ki-enchian hen; huchi a midang toh kiteh a, ki-uangsak lou a, amah mah a suanhuai thil ahihtheihna ding in.
english: But let each man test his own work, and then he will take pride in himself and not in his neighbor.

paite: Michih in ama puak mah po ding ahi ngal a.
english: For each man will bear his own burden.

paite: Thuhilh a ommi in thil hoih tengteng ahilhpa kiang ah pe sam hen.
english: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

paite: Zekhem in om kei un; Pathian zaw khem a mawkbawl vual ahi kei; mi'n atuh peuh uh huai mah at nawn ngei ding ahih ziak un.
english: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

paite: Amah salam a tuh in sa a om siatna a-at ding a, khalam a tuh in bel kha a kipan tangtawn hinna a-at ding hi.
english: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

paite: Huchi in thil hoih hih chimtak kei ni; i lungkiak keileh ahuntak ah i at ngei ding uhi.
english: Let us not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.

paite: Huchi in lemtang hun i neihdan bang zel in mi tengteng tung ah thil hoih hih ni, ginna inkuanpihte lak a omte tung ah hi kholdiak hen.
english: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

paite: Keimah khut mahmah a na kiang ua laimal gol pipi a ka gelh en un.
heading: Vauna Nanung
english: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

paite: Sa a mel kilawmsak utte peuhmah in zeksum a om ding in nou ahon sawl teitei nak uhi; bangmah dang ziak ahi kei, Khrist kros ziak a sawina athuaklouhna ding lel uh ahi.
english: As many as desire to look good in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

paite: Zeksumte nangawn in leng dan azui tuan sam kei ua, na sa uah, suan ding aneihtheihna ding un na zek uh kisumleh chih a-ut lel uh ahi.
english: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.

paite: Ke'n zaw i Toupa Jesu Khrist kros lou ngal ka suan louh ding dan, huai kros ziak in khovel kei a ding in kilhden in a-om a, kei leng khovel a ding in kilhden in ka om hi.
english: But far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

paite: Siam thak nawnna lou zaw zeksum bangmah ahi kei a, zeksum louh leng bangmah ahi sam kei hi.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

paite: Huai dan bang a om peuhmahte tung ah lemna leh zahngaihna, Israel' Pathian tung ngei ah om hen.
english: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

paite: Tuban siah kuamah in hon hihbuai nawn kei hen; ka pumpi ah Jesu chiamtehnate ka pu ngal a.
english: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

paite: Unaute aw, Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kha uah om hen. Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
